title: Audit event, schema v1
description: One message on the audit-events Kafka topic. Producers: utils/audit (Go) and the Python services. Kafka key: "<resource.type>/<resource.id>" (or event_id when there is no resource). Headers: content-type: application/json, audit-schema-version: 1, traceparent (W3C) when the request is traced.

event_id.description: UUIDv7 set by the producer; re-deliveries keep it, so the consumer de-duplicates on it.

service.description: Producing service, same as its OTEL_SERVICE_NAME.

action.description: <resource>.<verb> in lower case (product.update), or the full gRPC method / "METHOD /path" for events recorded automatically.

before.description: Full state before the action, any JSON value at any depth, secrets redacted. Absent on create.

after.description: Full state after the action. Absent on delete.

path.description: JSON Pointer style; array elements matched by identity appear as <key>=<value>, e.g. /variants/id=v1/stock.

from.description: Present for remove and replace (may be null).

to.description: Present for add and replace (may be null).

truncated.description: before/after dropped for size, or changes cut at 500.
